The '''CE-2 Transport''' was a class of [[Freighter/Legends|light freighter]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].

==Characteristics==
The transport had a three-part design, with the middle section consisting of the barge cargo pod. The ship was 100 meters in length, crewed by two pilots, and capable of carrying two passengers. Though relatively slow and lightly armored, the ship boasted 50,000 metric tons of storage in its cargo pod.
